en: Color postcard showing a winter evening view of Sibiu's medieval fortifications: a massive octagonal stone tower with machicolations and a covered wooden walkway along the brick wall, flanked by a snowy street with car light trails and historic houses. The reverse has the Poșta Română logo, address lines, and a multilingual caption identifying the towers of Sibiu's medieval fortification, plus printer and photographer credits.
